name: InVideo
tagline: InVideo is an AI-powered video creation platform that turns text, scripts, or blog posts into professional videos using stock footage, AI voiceover, and automated editing. Its library of 5,000+ templates covers ads, explainers, social content, and news formats. Marketers and content teams use InVideo to produce video content at scale without needing video editing skills.
